The main takeaway from our work is that
leaner CGC are able to survive in a postnatal environment with lower basal [Ca2+], which may be due to the presence of other VGCC.
leaner and totttering CGC show a similar decrease in basal [Ca2+], but leaner CGC die, while tottering CGC survive.
